name: Symal Group Limited
summary: Symal Group Limited provides contracting, plant and equipment hire, material sales, recycling, and remediation services in Australia. It operates through three segments: Contracting Services, Plant and Equipment, and Other segments. The company offers electrical services, concrete construction, hard and soft landscaping, bridge and heavy civil structures construction, plumbing / drainage works, and managing subcontractors and suppliers, as well as manages small to large-scale complex projects in head contractor and subcontractor capacities.
